steps.content: Sinking. Sinking endlessly. Consciousness is dragged into the abyss.
Then, a single strand of red light appears.
It's a lifeline from that young person. A chance for escape.
That person came here with a purpose, much like your own.
He is a good soul, radiant with justice, and he has helped you enact your self-punishment.
steps.female_content: She is a good soul, radiant with justice, and she has helped you enact your self-punishment.

steps.content: Look upon your irredeemable sins, Hilda. Look upon your shattered heart, Hilda.
That person showed you a world so similar to your own: the gleaming metropoles and weary satellite towns, the idealistic youth and the corrupt politicians, the same shadows festering beneath it all.
He offered a hand. But you were already in pieces. What could you possibly give?
steps.female_content: She offered a hand. But you were already in pieces. What could you possibly give?

steps.content: It is all too late now.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I really wish... I had met you sooner...
With this lament, her gaze drifts once more to that light not far away.
How cruel it looks, a single, brilliant promise in this vast, consuming darkness.
A light meant to illuminate the future, not to be touched by a failure like her.
And so her hand goes limp. Her fingertips graze yours in a final, fleeting brush as she lets go.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hilda?! No!!
You thrash downward, desperate to catch her, to pull her back. But the chasm between you only widens.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Damn it... This distance... even my shackles can't reach...
The Mania-contaminated sludge coils around her, an anchor dragging her down toward the abyss.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ${PlayerName}... I won't be leaving with you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I've been asleep for too long... so long I didn't even know my own city-state was gone.
The violent surge of Mania subsides, and with it, the fury in her.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: In your memories, I saw familiar shadows. DisCity may be heading down the same path as the metropoles. If you truly want to stop it... you must become stronger than it.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Recruiting a teammate who's always failing would be bad luck. It's better if I stop right here.

With a wave of feigned casualness, she unleashes a final, massive surge of Mania from within—not as an attack, but as a beacon, exposing her greatest vulnerability. In an instant, the greedy shadows surrounding you forget your presence. They surge toward her, a swarm drawn to a brighter flame.
In contrast, her scattered memories transform. They become code strips of the bygone era, fluttering like butterfly wings, gently surrounding you in a protective cocoon.
She vanishes from your sight. Then the sludge, the entire oppressive space. It all dissolves around you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What are you doing? Hey! Hilda!
You pound your fists against the barrier that now encases you. From a great distance, her voice reaches you, tinged with a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: If you ever speak of me to others... make it a cautionary tale. A story about someone who took the wrong path and paid the price for her foolishness.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Go protect your city-state, ${PlayerName}. The new era belongs to you. Don't let it stray down our old road.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: As a ghost from a bygone era... this single warning is all I have left to give.
The filth crawls over her, and the familiar shackles snap shut once more. The consciousness she had fought so hard to maintain finally begins to disintegrate.
Decades of resentment and despair, shattered by a final act, complete their work. She is remade, fully, into a Corruptor, a wanderer in the eternal darkness.
When you finally break free from your cage, it is too late. You can only watch, helpless, as the last echoes of her memory slip through your fingers like smoke, disappearing into the void.
With her disappearance, the time Schorl granted you runs out.
The space begins to crystallize, then freeze, as your connection to her is irrevocably severed.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Farewell, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...There's no place for me in this new era.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: To be buried with the era that created me... is the only fitting end.
